item.title: A Great-Looking CS2 Inventory for $55: Three Sets That Don't Look Cheap
item.description: What you can build in CS2 for $55: three ready-made sets in blue, red and green, no knife or gloves, with live prices for every skin.

item.title: Which Gloves Go With a Purple Knife: Pairings for Four Budgets
item.description: A purple CS2 knife means Ultraviolet or Doppler Phase 2. Gloves that match: Mogul, Finish Line, Needle Point, the new Violet Beadwork, with live prices.

item.title: What Goes With the AK-47 Redline: Knife, Gloves and Pistols for Any Budget
item.description: Building around the AK-47 Redline: gloves, knife, M4, AWP and pistols in red and black. Three ready-made sets from $45 to $500 with live prices.
